purpose: Single registry of component/function/capability catalogs across A-TownChain-Okosystems. This source registry is the staging manifest for producing one normalized master catalog; it is not itself proof that all source records have been imported or verified.

authority.role: Architecture, ownership, integration, compliance and evidence control plane only
authority.canonical_implementation_rule: Catalog aggregation must not transfer or duplicate implementation ownership.

merge_policy.normalized_id_rule: Use a stable namespace derived from source repository and source catalog ID; retain the original ID and source_record.
merge_policy.semantic_overlap: Mark as POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE and reconcile explicitly; never silently delete or merge records.
merge_policy.counts: Keep source counts separate until record-level import and reconciliation are complete. Do not sum overlapping catalog classes as unique functions.
merge_policy.verification: Catalog presence, source mapping, implementation, tests and functional verification are separate states.
merge_policy.unresolved_consensus: BLOCKED until an approved versioned normative decision exists.
merge_policy.implementation_order: Finish source inventory, contracts, validation and reconciliation before implementation changes.

completion_gates: Every active repository and every discovered catalog/list is registered or has a reasoned exclusion.
Every source record is imported with original ID, provenance and source hash preserved.
Every component/function/capability/interface is classified by record kind and canonical owner.
Potential duplicates and semantic overlaps are reconciled explicitly; no record is silently discarded.
Every runtime source candidate is mapped to a catalog record or explicitly excluded with rationale.
Schema validation, uniqueness checks, count reconciliation and source reconciliation pass on the exact commit SHA.
Functional verification is only claimed with exact-SHA Run-to-Job-to-Step evidence and terminal logs.
The pull request remains Draft and unmerged while any required gate is residual or blocked.
residuals: This manifest registers known source catalogs; it does not yet contain a lossless record-level union of all source catalogs.
Current catalog JSON payloads must be imported and normalized by deterministic tooling, not by manually copying summary counts.
Additional catalogs in the remaining active repositories must be discovered and registered.
No functional verification is inferred from catalog membership.

repository_scope.discovery_method: GitHub organization repository listing; active/archive state from repository metadata
repository_scope.rule: Every active repository must be scanned for catalog-like files, manifests, registries, APIs, source symbols, workflows and capability declarations. Record explicit exclusions with evidence. Archived repositories are reference-only unless a maintained canonical dependency requires inclusion.
known_scope_residuals: A repository being listed here does not mean its catalog files have been discovered.
Private repository content may require an authenticated inventory pass.
Source-language AST and YAML/workflow inventories need dedicated extractors and scope declarations.
